metadata.title: Dedicated Access Workstation (DAW) Endpoint SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan defining the Dedicated Access Workstation (DAW), the highest-assurance endpoint execution environment for institutional privileged and Level 4 data access.

import-profile.remarks: Institutional security and privacy baseline profile.

system-characteristics.system-description: A single-purpose, institution-owned endpoint designed exclusively for privileged operations and access to the most sensitive institutional data and control planes.

props.name: inherits-from-sspp
props.remarks: DAW endpoints inherit all COBO L2 requirements and add maximal assurance constraints.

props.name: assurance-model
props.remarks: Provides the highest level of endpoint assurance available.

props.name: execution-model
props.remarks: DAW endpoints are restricted to access-only and administrative workflows; general-purpose usage is prohibited.

props.name: eligible-data-classifications
props.remarks: DAW endpoints are required for workflows involving Level 4 data.

props.name: non-equivalence-statement
props.remarks: DAW status does not confer automatic entitlement to Level 4 data; all data access remains governed by Secure Data policies.

props.name: privileged-access-only
props.remarks: DAWs are intended solely for privileged administration and high-risk workflows.

props.name: general-productivity
props.remarks: Email, web browsing, collaboration tools, and general productivity workloads are prohibited.

props.name: cryptographic-identity
props.remarks: Endpoint identity must be TPM-backed, PKI-issued, and support hardware attestation of boot and security state.

props.name: cryptographic-compliance
props.remarks: All cryptographic operations must use FIPS 140-3 validated modules.

props.name: implementation-baseline
props.remarks: DAW implementations must meet applicable CIS Benchmarks and DISA STIG requirements at the highest feasible severity level.

props.name: network-access-model
props.remarks: DAW network access is tightly constrained, segmented, and brokered to approved control planes only.

props.name: lifecycle-governance
props.remarks: DAW enrollment, suspension, recovery, and retirement require elevated approval and enhanced auditability.

props.name: zero-trust-alignment
props.remarks: DAW posture and identity are continuously evaluated and required for all privileged and Level 4 access decisions.

system-implementation.remarks: DAW endpoints implement Secure Endpoint trust by inheriting COBO L2 controls and applying maximal isolation and assurance constraints.

roles.title: DAW Authorized User
roles.remarks: Authorized operator permitted to use DAWs for privileged and sensitive workflows.

roles.title: Endpoint Security Operations
roles.remarks: Responsible for DAW configuration, monitoring, incident response, and lifecycle enforcement.

roles.title: Endpoint Governance Authority
roles.remarks: Approves DAW eligibility, access scope, and lifecycle transitions.

control-implementation.remarks: DAW endpoints inherit all Secure Endpoint and COBO L2 trust requirements and apply additional maximal assurance constraints. OS-specific DAW implementations (Windows, Linux) define concrete CIS and STIG-aligned configurations.
